full_judgment: 4. The predecessor of the present petitioners and pro-forma-respondent Nos. 8 and 9 of the present civil .petition for leave to appeal as defendant Nos. 1,6 and 7 in the aforesaid Title Suit No. 228 of 1984 con-tested the suit on filing. a joint written statement stating therein in the written statement denying all the material allegation made in the plaint and contended, inter-alia, that the suit of the plaintiff is not maintainable in it's present form and manner and the same is barred by limitation and the suit. land originally belonged to C.S. recorded tenants, Kashinath and others and thereafter due to arrear of rents the suit land including other undisputed land was sold in auction and the Government purchased the suit land in auction sale vide certificate case No. 135 of 1955-56 and thereby the Government went into possession of the suit land including other undisputed land which during S.A. operation was wrongly recorded in the name of Panchu Rishhi and others and for that the Tahsildcr, Gopalpur of Monirampur Police Station filed objection Case No. 52 of 1956 under Section 19(1) of the 1.B.S.A. and T. Act against the said wrong preparation of S.A. record and that Objection case on proper hearing of both sides was allowed and aforesaid initial S.A. record of Panchu Muchi @ Rishi and others was cancelled and title and possession of the Government to the suit land was established on due cancellation of wrong S.A. Kh.125 of the suit land. Thus when the Government was in peaceful possession with the title as stated above in the suit land and other undisputed land on due inclusion of the same in the Government's S.A. khatian No. 1 settled 24 decimals of land from disputed plot No. 170 with an area of 12 decimals, Plot No. 178 with a area of 02 decimals and undisputed plot No.188/698 with an area of 10 decimals to the defendant No. 1 vide settlement case No. 29/XIII/61-62 on 30.06.1961 on due realisation of salami from the settlement holder, the defendant No. 1 on 07.08.1961 and thereby the defendant No. 1 on the strength of the aforesaid settlement has mutated his name for the said land on regular payment of tent to the Government and the Government has also executed a registered kabuliyat on 02.01.1979 for the said 24 decimals of land in favour of the defendant No. 1. After registration of the aforesaid kabuliyat the plaintiff has created the so-called collusive kobala dated 22.02.1979 and when the plaintiff on the basis of the said deed dated 22.02.1979 threatened the defendant No. 1 to dispossess him from the suit land the defendant No. 1 filed Title Suit No. 400 of 1983 wherein the defendant No. 1 obtained injunction against the plaintiff and the said title suit is still pending in the Monirarnpur Upazila Munsif Adalat. The defendant Nos. 1, 6 and 7 took eksonsa lease from the Government' for 04 decimals in. Plot No. 170, 08 decimals in Plot N0.176 and 04 decimals in Plot No.178 respectively and the defendant Nos. 6 and 7 arc residing therein by constructing katcha dwelling houses. S.A. record in S.A. Khatian No. 5 is wrong and S.A. Khatian 125 will be cancelled of the mouza concerned and the note is therein the 'working volume' of S.A. record also stands alike. So plaintiffs case is liable to be dismissed with cost.
